name: Kishōtenketsu
axiom: A twist that reframes what came before needs no villain and no conflict.
trigger: Product reveals, design retrospectives, and audiences who resist being told there is a problem to defeat.

steps.text: Ten: a turn that recontextualises everything so far.
Ketsu: hold the new reading together without a fight.

antiPattern.violation: Importing a conflict the material does not have, so a straightforward improvement is dressed as a battle with an enemy.
antiPattern.remediation: Let the turn do the work. If no one opposes the change, the twist is what refreshes attention.

origin.title: Kishotenketsu
origin.publication: Classical Chinese and Japanese narrative tradition

prompt: The turn that reframes our subject is ______.
